summary: Frontend-only testing of new static page partners.html on the preview URL. Verified page shell (utility bar, dark header, side-menu, footer, Get In Touch CTA), intro copy/breadcrumb/H1, both partner sections, all 19 images (7 architect cards + 12 financial logos) render real decoded pixels (naturalWidth>0, zero broken), responsive column counts and zero horizontal overflow at 1920/1024/390, side-menu open+close, REGISTER INTEREST navigation, and PARTNERS side-menu link navigation from all 15 other pages. No JS console errors anywhere. The dev-reported 'black boxes' flakiness did NOT reproduce in a real browser: all 7 architect images decode and paint (verified via naturalWidth/naturalHeight and screenshots at desktop + mobile).

issues: Name captions are white text at 12px placed over images at opacity .5; on the lighter cards (Armani/Casa, Planac Mimarlik, Omer Camoglu) the white label sits on a light gray area and contrast is marginal (<3:1). Consider a subtle bottom gradient scrim or slightly darker overlay for legibility (matches Bilgili visually but reads weak).
At 1920px the 6-col grid inside max-width:1200px yields only ~158px square cards, so the 7th card sits alone on a second row leaving a large empty gap; acceptable vs reference but visually sparse.

action_items: Optional: the 7 architect cards are <a href="#"> — clicking them does nothing but appends '#' to the URL and shows a pointer/hover state implying a link. Either remove the anchor (use div) or point to real partner URLs.
Optional (design): improve contrast of .pt-arch-name captions over light images.
critical_code_review_comments: partners.html side-menu/footer/CTA markup is byte-identical to team.html (verified by diff) — good consistency, but this shared chrome is duplicated across 16 static pages; any future change requires 16 edits. Consider a build-time include/partial.
Side-menu CONTACT item uses href="#register" but partners.html has no #register section (same as team.html), so the link is a no-op on this page — pre-existing site-wide pattern, not introduced here.
context_for_next_testing_agent: partners.html fully verified at iteration 12: 19/19 images render, no console errors, no overflow at 1920/1024/390, PARTNERS side-menu link works from all 15 pages, REGISTER INTEREST -> index.html#register works, menu open/close works (#menuToggle / #menuClose). Only cosmetic items remain: architect cards have href='#' and caption contrast is marginal on light cards. Financial logo alt/testid vs artwork mismatch (turkiye-petrolleri shows 'Tera Portfoy', private-banking shows 'Postbank') confirmed present but not user-visible (no captions rendered).
rca_of_the_issue: Dev-time 'solid black box' architect images were a headless screenshot decode artifact; in the real browser run all images reported complete=true with valid naturalWidth/Height (350-700px) and painted correctly in both desktop and mobile screenshots.
